what: M&T Bank is a regional bank serving New York State, the mid-Atlantic and New England. It is known for conservative commercial lending, and also owns Wilmington Trust, a corporate trust and wealth business.
customers: Households and small businesses in its branch markets, commercial borrowers, and institutional trust clients.
money: commercial and industrial lending and commercial real estate
moat: A century-long record of conservative underwriting through cycles, with deposit relationships in markets where it is the leading community bank.
risks: Commercial property, especially offices in the Northeast, is a concentrated exposure
Deposit costs rise with competition for savings
Its markets grow more slowly than the Sunbelt
Regional bank capital rules are being tightened
opportunities: Net margin of 29% with a dividend yield above 3%
Credit losses have consistently been below peers through past downturns
Buybacks have been substantial while capital remains strong
watch: Commercial real estate credit metrics and net interest margin.
